title: Mechanisms of Sr sorption in peaty-podzolic-gleyic and alluvial soddy-gleyic soils
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,3471-3481
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00464K, Paper
Anna Semenkova, Yulia Izosimova, Aleksandra Rzhevskaia, Andrey Toropov, Maria Pyatova, Anna Romanchuk, Stepan Kalmykov, Inna Tolpeshta
Radiostrontium (90Sr), a highly mobile radionuclide of environmental concern, can be strongly retained by soils via interactions with organic and mineral components.
